title: Senior Full Stack Engineer (Python & React)
company_profile: CloudScale Systems provides high-throughput API gateway infrastructure for modern enterprise cloud environments.
description: We are expanding our core platform team to build low-latency event processing services. You will design, develop, test, and deploy microservices powering over 40 million API transactions daily while collaborating closely with product designers and DevOps engineers.
requirements: 5+ years software engineering experience in Python, FastAPI, TypeScript, React. Strong proficiency with PostgreSQL, Docker, and distributed systems. BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
benefits: Comprehensive medical, dental, vision coverage with 100% employer paid premiums. 401(k) matching up to 5%. Flexible PTO policy, wellness stipends, and $2,000 annual learning allowance.

title: Medical Receptionist & Scheduling Coordinator
company_profile: Lakeshore Community Health Network operates outpatient ambulatory clinics serving urban communities across metropolitan Chicago.
description: Join our front office team greeting patients, verifying commercial and Medicaid health insurance eligibility, managing provider scheduling calendars, and processing copayments in compliance with HIPAA guidelines.
requirements: 2+ years experience in a clinic or dental office reception role. Familiarity with Epic or Cerner EHR software. Strong bilingual communication skills (English/Spanish preferred). High school diploma or GED.
benefits: Standard group health plan (BCBS), 15 days paid annual leave, public transit commuter subsidies, and tuition assistance for healthcare certifications.

title: Digital Marketing & Social Media Coordinator
company_profile: GreenPulse Lifestyle Brands designs sustainable home goods and organic apparel marketed through direct-to-consumer digital channels.
description: We are looking for a creative marketer to lead Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest organic engagement. You will draft monthly content calendars, coordinate sample shipments to micro-influencers, track Google Analytics referral funnels, and report on campaign ROAS.
requirements: 1-3 years experience managing social media accounts for consumer brands. Portfolio of creative copy and short-form video work. Familiarity with Canva, Sprout Social, and Shopify analytics.
benefits: 401(k), 40% employee merchandise discount, remote work flexibility 2 days per week, and monthly cell phone allowance.

title: Online Customer Support & Chat Specialist
company_profile: NextGen Media Solutions is a digital affiliate advertising agency scaling rapid influencer campaigns.
description: Looking for customer agents to respond to inquiries via Telegram and Google Hangouts. Initial training materials and proprietary software must be purchased from our certified equipment vendor using an advance check mailed to your address.
requirements: Must have laptop, Telegram messenger account, and willingness to deposit company check for certified software license verification.
benefits: Flexible hours, work anywhere in the world, $30/hr after training verification fee cleared.

title: Administrative Assistant - Immediate Remote Placement
company_profile: Apex Logistical Consultants LLC specializes in freight coordination across North America.
description: We are seeking enthusiastic home typists to process client package receipts and data entries. You will receive shipments at your residential address, inspect contents, re-label packages, and reship them within 24 hours to designated forwarding addresses.
requirements: Ability to receive large parcels at home address. Must be 18 years old with reliable printer to print shipping labels. Basic knowledge of MS Word.
benefits: $35/hour base plus $20 per repackaged item handled. Equipment purchase reimbursement checks provided upfront.

title: Wire Transfer Clerk / Financial Processing Agent
company_profile: Swift Global Apex is an international investment advisory handling offshore rapid liquidation and personal disbursement services.
description: Looking for immediate work from home agents to facilitate daily bank account transfers and check deposit liquidations. No interview required. Receive daily checks, deposit into your personal account, keep 10% commission, and remit remaining balances via Western Union/Bitcoin immediately.
requirements: Must have an active personal bank account older than 6 months. High speed internet, smartphone for instant SMS communications, and ability to execute transactions within 2 hours of funds arriving.
benefits: Keep 10% of every wire received ($500-$1000 daily). Fully flexible work hours. No supervisor oversight.
